relinst.name: Rationale - freeze

condition.expression: 'True match against an asset freeze designation with binding nexus and no applicable licence. Freezing is required on knowledge or reasonable cause to suspect - Russia Regs reg 11, EU Reg 269/2014 Art 2, OFAC blocking with the 50 percent rule where ownership derived, FATF R.6 without delay. Funds are held, never returned - return would itself make funds available'

relinst.name: Rationale - reject

condition.expression: 'True match on a payment the institution must refuse: making funds available to a designated party or its owned entity - reg 12, EU Art 2 paragraph 2 - processing via a reg 17A designated bank, or an OFAC sectoral directive prohibiting the documented dealing. No blockable property interest is held so the payment is rejected and reported'

relinst.name: Rationale - process under licence

condition.expression: 'True match but every bound blocking exposure is covered by a licence in force on the payment date whose ground matches the documented purpose. Process strictly within the licence terms: conditions, caps across the designated person group, usage reporting windows and six year UK record keeping. A licence from one authority never licenses another authority exposure'

relinst.name: Rationale - refer

condition.expression: 'The hit cannot be safely discounted or safely actioned on the available evidence: partial corroboration, unresolved ownership or control questions, policy only exposure, licence doubt or message integrity indicators. Strict civil liability means processing while investigating is never safe - restrict access now per the Wise lesson and refer to the MLRO with the unresolved points named'

relinst.name: Rationale - false positive

condition.expression: 'The screened party is affirmatively differentiated from the listed target: at least two independent mismatching identifiers or one decisive identifier against every listed value, or the hit rests solely on a low quality alias, or ownership resolved clear below every family threshold on complete fresh registry evidence. Documented per OFSI name match guidance, OFAC FAQ 5 and FATF criterion 6.6 false positive release'

relinst.name: Next step - freeze standard

condition.expression: countRelationshipInstances(%S,'has integrity indicator',*)

'Freeze all funds and economic resources immediately and restrict account access. Do not return any in flight funds. Report to every bound authority on its own clock, obtain MLRO sign off, archive the evidence tree and diarise the annual frozen asset reviews'

relinst.name: Next step - reject

condition.expression: 'Refuse the payment and do not execute. File the reject reports on each bound authority clock, record the refusal rationale, apply interim restrictions to the customer relationship pending MLRO review and consider the SAR question separately'

relinst.name: Next step - process under licence

condition.expression: 'Release strictly within the licence terms. Record the licence reference against the payment, complete the licence usage report inside its window, keep records six years for UK licences and ten for OFAC, and re verify licence validity before any further payment'

relinst.name: Next step - refer

condition.expression: 'Suspend the activity and restrict access pending decision. Assemble the referral pack naming each unresolved point, raise any correspondent RFI for missing payment fields, and route to the MLRO or sanctions officer - only that role decides freeze, reject or release'

relinst.name: Next step - false positive

condition.expression: 'Close with the field by field comparison recorded: every listed identifier against every customer value with the elimination logic invoked. Retain the rationale, apply any required second review, and note the discount does not carry over if the list entry later changes'
